purpose: Fail-closed decision register for the exact eight Batch B patient-access and encounter-master requirements. Existing matrix dispositions remain unapproved candidates; these records do not claim evidence normalization, appointment, approval, implementation equivalence, or parity acceptance.

evidence.note: Authoritatively reviewed ward, room and bed-master evidence is pending.

normal.description: Create an active synthetic ward, room and bed hierarchy, then allocate an available bed during a synthetic inpatient admission.
expected_results: The hierarchy, capacity and active status are consistent in registration and inpatient context.
The allocation creates one attributable occupancy interval and reconciles with availability, charges and reports.

denial_or_correction.description: Attempt duplicate bed coding, allocation of an occupied bed, and retirement of a location with an active synthetic stay; then correct an erroneous bed assignment.
expected_results: Invalid, conflicting or unsafe state changes are denied without partial occupancy changes.
Authorized correction preserves the original and corrected location history and reconciles downstream charge and occupancy totals.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve ward/room/bed hierarchy, capacity and status rules, allocation corrections, and all synthetic inpatient downstream effects.

appointment_dependencies.required_scope: Canonical master-data disposition and bounded teaching scope.
Bed selection, admission and correction workflow.
Ward, room, bed, capacity, availability and retirement rules.
Clinical location continuity and transfer/discharge consequences.
Encounter location history and record attribution.
Class/location charge and claim-reference reconciliation.
Occupancy, availability and historical control totals.
Master-data change authorization and audit boundaries.

evidence.note: Authoritatively reviewed payment-method master evidence is pending.

normal.description: Activate a versioned synthetic payment method and select it during a permitted synthetic registration.
expected_results: The encounter stores the canonical payment-method version and intended payer context.
Billing, claim-simulation, receipt and report dimensions reconcile without contacting any live payer service.

denial_or_correction.description: Select an inactive or incompatible payment method, attempt a wrong-role master change, then correct the payment method before and after a simulated charge exists.
expected_results: Inactive, incompatible and unauthorized actions are denied without partial financial state.
Authorized correction follows owner-approved timing rules and preserves before-and-after billing, claim and audit reconciliation.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve payment-method codes, versions, encounter compatibility, correction timing and finance/claim/report consequences in simulation only.

appointment_dependencies.required_scope: Canonical disposition and teaching boundary.
Payer selection and encounter correction workflow.

Payer dimensions and financial/encounter control totals.
Master change authorization, audit and external-service isolation.

normal.description: Activate a versioned synthetic encounter/accommodation class and use it for an eligible synthetic inpatient admission.
expected_results: Class, eligible room/bed and payer context are consistent at admission.

denial_or_correction.description: Attempt an ineligible or inactive class selection, then correct or change class during an active synthetic stay.
expected_results: Invalid selection is denied without changing bed or financial state.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve class codes, eligibility, effective dating, class-change correction and downstream bed/finance/claim/report behavior.

appointment_dependencies.required_scope: Canonical class-master disposition and bounded scope.

normal.description: Register a known synthetic patient for inpatient care using active unit, class, payer and available-bed masters, then hand off the created episode.
expected_results: Exactly one inpatient episode and one occupancy interval are created with attributable registrar action.
Patient, episode, location, clinical queue, RM, finance/claim simulation and census views reconcile to the same identifiers and state.

denial_or_correction.description: Attempt duplicate active admission, occupied/ineligible bed allocation and wrong-role registration; then correct payer, class, location or cancel an erroneous admission under owner-approved timing rules.
expected_results: Invalid or unauthorized attempts create no partial episode, occupancy or charge.
Authorized correction/cancellation preserves prior values, releases or changes capacity exactly once, and reconciles clinical, RM, finance and report state.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve inpatient registration inputs, duplicate prevention, admission/correction/cancellation states, bed effects and every cross-domain handoff.

Admission, occupancy and census control totals.

evidence.note: The external legacy destination was not opened and no authoritatively reviewed business-display evidence is recorded.

normal.description: Display a minimized synthetic admission/queue status set for an authorized teaching location using non-identifying display labels.
expected_results: Only approved synthetic fields and current states are visible for the intended location.
The display uses authenticated or otherwise owner-approved safe access, accessible rendering and traceable release/configuration provenance.

denial_or_correction.description: Attempt public or wrong-location access, inject a real-looking identifier, and correct a stale or cancelled synthetic queue item.
expected_results: Unauthorized access and prohibited identifier content are blocked without disclosure.
Correction removes or updates stale display state while preserving source encounter and audit history.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve the admission-display business need, minimized fields, audience/access, freshness/correction and explicit prohibition on insecure or real-data patterns.

appointment_dependencies.required_scope: Candidate replacement/exclusion decision and teaching scope.

normal.description: Map a representative synthetic Rawat Jalan v2 input and outcome to the proposed canonical outpatient registration path without creating a second episode.
expected_results: Every required field, state and downstream effect has an explicit mapped, excluded or unresolved result for owner decision.
If consolidation is approved later, one canonical episode, queue item and audit chain result with a retained migration trace.

denial_or_correction.description: Present an unmapped or conflicting v2 rule, use a retired v2 deep link, and correct an erroneous migration mapping.
expected_results: Unmapped/conflicting behavior blocks consolidation approval and retired deep links cannot create an episode.
Authorized mapping correction preserves original mapping evidence and reconciles patient, encounter, queue, RM, finance/claim and report outcomes.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve or reject consolidation only after complete v2-to-canonical field/rule/state mapping, exclusions, migration trace and downstream reconciliation.
